stories.title: Corgis lead hikers to a fairy village in the Maine woods

stories.title: City urges caution along Oahu’s shoreline, dangerous surf expected
stories.summary: The City and County of Honolulu is urging residents and visitors to exercise extreme caution along Oʻahu’s shorelines, as dangerously large surf is expected to hit the island’s north- and west-facing shores.

stories.title: Mayor sparks controversy for waving Confederate flag in stands at high school football game
stories.summary: A Confederate flag appeared in the stands of an Arkansas high school’s final home game of the regular season.

stories.title: ‘I want to know who killed my son’: Father seeks answers after boy, 7, found shot to death
stories.summary: Police are investigating the death of a 7-year-old boy who was found shot inside a North Carolina home.

stories.title: Hawaii defeats Grand Canyon to take Mountain West championship
stories.summary: The Rainbow Wahine defeated Grand Canyon Wednesday to win the Mountain West volleyball championship and secure an automatic berth in the NCAA Tournament.

stories.title: Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade postponed due to expected bad weather
stories.summary: The 100th annual Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade in New York City will be postponed to Saturday due to weather.

stories.title: Storms postpone Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade
stories.summary: The 100th Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade is postponed to Saturday. Hear from the bands who traveled far to march in it.

stories.title: 22-year-old killed in daycare parking lot by man she went on 1 date with 3 years ago, police say
stories.summary: Lauren Becker, 22, was stabbed while arriving at work at Kids Can Community Center in Omaha, police said. A suspect was arrested in Minnesota.

stories.title: HPD shuts down illegal gambling room on Kinau Street, seizes 15 gaming machines
stories.summary: Police recovered 15 gaming machines, more than $2,000 in cash and illicit drugs, which were submitted into evidence.

stories.title: Mom of 4 killed by husband after allegedly arguing over children’s Christmas gifts, reports say
stories.summary: A Georgia man is accused of fatally shooting his wife after an argument about Christmas gifts for their four children, authorities said.

stories.title: Covering the Cost: The cost of education and workforce training
stories.summary: Annalisa Burgos speaks with the Fehoko football family about their late-career pivot to workforce development and the price of education and job training.
